mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10Y-2Y < 0) within the next 6 months, or GDP growth decelerates in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to a hawkish Fed response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Core PCE inflation remains below 2% over the next 6 months, or the Fed does not raise rates by more than 25bps in the next meeting.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Core PCE inflation remains below 2% over the next 6 months, or the ISM Manufacturing PMI rises above 55 in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, defined as an increase of more than 50 basis points in a single meeting, signals a hawkish Fed pivot that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by > 50bps in a single meeting
failure_condition: The Fed reverses course and cuts rates in the next meeting, or the 2-year Treasury yield falls below the 10-year yield within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the year-over-year change in the HOUST index, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The NAHB Housing Market Index rises above 60 in the following month, or the 30-year fixed mortgage rate falls below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating increase in nonfarm payrolls, as measured by the 3-month moving average of the PAYEMS series, signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Initial jobless claims rise above 400,000 in the next month, or the ISM Services PMI falls below 50.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the CPI index, defined as a 0.5% month-over-month increase in CPIAUCSL, signals a surge in inflation that will drive a hawkish Fed response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Fed does not raise rates by more than 25bps in the next meeting, or the 5-year breakeven inflation rate falls below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real consumer spending, as measured by the year-over-year change in the RSAFS series, signals a surge in demand that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a drop in the unemployment rate.
failure_condition: Real retail sales fall month-over-month in the next release, or the unemployment rate rises above 5%.
